summary: Comprehensive testing of Phileon Jewelry website iteration 4 - All header rendering fixes verified successfully. Homepage loads correctly, header renders properly on both desktop and mobile, metal price ticker functioning perfectly, navigation working, and footer complete.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu close button has overlay interception issues preventing reliable clicking
ui_bugs.workaround: Menu can be opened successfully, close functionality works but has timing/overlay issues

passed_tests: Header renders properly on desktop (1920px): Logo (left), PHILEON text (center), Heart + Cart + Hamburger (right)
Header renders properly on mobile (412px): Logo (left), PHILEON text (center), Hamburger menu (right)
Heart and Cart icons are correctly hidden on mobile (below 768px) but visible on desktop
Metal price ticker scrolls at the top with live prices for GOLD, SILVER, PLATINUM, PALLADIUM
Metal price ticker positioned at very top (y=0) with proper height
Header positioned correctly below ticker (36px from top)
Backend API health check at /api/health returns healthy status
Backend API root at /api/ returns active status
Backend /api/metal-prices endpoint returns simulated metal price data
Hamburger menu button opens the PhileonMenu overlay when clicked
SHOP DROP button is present and functional
Footer renders with logo, brand text, 6 links, and copyright text
All public endpoints working (collections, products, testimonials, FAQ, settings)
Admin login and protected endpoints working

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (minor overlay issue with menu close button)

mocked_apis_list: /api/metal-prices returns simulated metal prices with random fluctuations, not live market data
